comment: April is an amazing professor, and is always there for her students. She really tries to get her students to pass, and is almost always available to help outside of class. Her lectures are long, but if you are into the material, they goby quickly. Tests are tough, and she does ask for attention to detail, but overall, she's great. Would take again.

This professor is amazing. She is so helpful and really wants her students to succeed. She is very forgiving if you make a mistake i.e. forgetting to turn in an assignment. But don't make a habit of it, because her patience wears thin quickly, as any professor's would. I wouldn't expect this much forgiveness in any higher level class.

One of the nicest professors I've encountered. She's tough, but that's how it should be. Other people are right in saying that her lectures are repetitive, but I never found them confusing. I honestly found them to be a little too simplified and cartoonish, but that's just me. I recommend her, but be ready to work.

She is a very nice lady but the course was hard like a college class should be. I went in loving Bio then I got some good help from her and came out dazzed, confused, and almost failed. If you take her you better study.
KEEP UP WITH THE READING! i found this class very difficult- while dr. hill was helpful, i found myself hopelessly lost after every lecture. very nice though, and willingly available.

AWESOME teacher! Gave online daily powerpoint notes, sample test questions, additional practice probles etc. Just had 2 attend class and pay attention. Exams were pretty much all short essay-hard. Dr. Hill does curve. She's very clear and breaks down concepts so that they are easier to understand. Always there to help even 4 private matters. GREAT!
Teaches straight from the book.  Easy course for the most part though.  Helpful teacher and very nice.  Highly reccomneded.
She's really nice and a good teacher.  ou have to make sure you keep up with reading and do problems in order to do well on her exams
She is very fair and very nice, and is always willing to give extra help.  Her tests can be hard, so keeping up with the reading and work is important throughout the semester.

Dr. Hill knows what she is talking about.  She is very helpful and clear.  The tests are difficult, but if you do the readings and come to class they are manageable.   The lectures follow the readings pretty much exactly, so sometimes a little repetitive.

Dr. Hill's class is fairly difficult, but she is very nice and always willing to help you outside of class until you understand the material.  She expects you to have a fairly good grasp of the material before coming to class, so you have to to keep up with the readings and do a lot of practice.

As long as you try you can do well in this class.  She is very helpful outside of class and will make time for you whenever you ask. In the lecture she explains the concepts very well, and lecture isn't too boring either.
Her lectures are not very clear to me, but that might be a personal issue. otherwise she is helpful outside of class.
